answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade, with the stake slashed when peers prove fake identities or double-spending. A hollow identity with no stake gets no haven: it cannot enter the market, while a prism of independent verifiers - reputation oracles, counterparties, and auditors - each checks a different facet of the agent history before vouching. Forging a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes, so the attack price grows linearly while honest agents pay nothing beyond the refundable deposit.
